title: In-memory data layer (lib/data)

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: lib/data/types.ts exports TypeScript types for Product, Review, Order, User, and Category, and `tsc --noEmit` passes with these types consumed by the repository (QA: TypeScript typecheck passes).

lib/data/fixtures.ts seeds deterministic in-memory data (stable IDs) sufficient to render a storefront listing, product detail, reviews, orders, and at least one seller user, so downstream challenge E2E flows have data to render (QA: storefront product listing renders).

lib/data/repository.ts exposes async accessor functions over the in-memory store (e.g. listProducts, getProduct, listReviews, listOrders, getUser) that each apply a simulated latency delay, so caching/streaming/waterfall behaviour is observable in later challenges.

lib/data/tags.ts exports stable cache TAG constants (e.g. per-entity and per-collection tag builders) that challenge solutions import for cacheTag / revalidateTag — no challenge hardcodes its own tag strings for shared entities.

The repository module is import-safe from both Server Components and Route Handlers (no top-level browser-only or framework-request APIs) and the included repository.test.ts proves at least one accessor returns seeded data.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
